claim: Floreffe Abbey runs hour-long guided tours of the abbey church April 1 to September 30 (closed Mondays except holidays) at 13h30, 14h30, 16h00 and 17h00 with extra 10h30/11h30 slots in July-August, at €8 per adult; the self-guided exterior tour costs €5 year-round via a guidebook sold at the mill-brewery.
quote: Individual Abbey Church Tours — April 1–September 30 (closed Mondays, except holidays; closed during Espéranzah festival July 24-29). Departure times: 1:30pm, 2:30pm, 4pm, 5pm. July-August additions: 10:30am, 11:30am. Cost: €8.00 per person.

claim: Floreffe is a Premonstratensian abbey founded in 1121 whose old mill-brewery offers daily tastings of abbey beers, cheese and bread, sitting roughly 18 km southwest of Liernu near the Sambre.
quote: Floreffe Abbey, founded in 1121 by Saint Norbert... The old mill-brewery offers tastings of abbey products: beers, bread, and cheeses.

claim: Les Jardins d'Annevoie 2026 admission is €12 adult / €9 student / €8 child (6-17) / free under 6, with a €35 annual pass; visits are self-guided via multilingual leaflet, and guided tours require 15-day-advance booking at €70 per guide for up to 25 people.
quote: Adult Individual: €12 | Group (20+): €11. Student (18-30): €9 individual / €8 group. Child (6-17): €8 individual / €7 group. Child (under 6): Free. Annual pass: €35.

claim: Annevoie's water gardens — Belgium's only surviving 18th-century water gardens — open for a special pre-season window 14 Feb-1 Mar 2026 (€7) and run their main season from 28 March to 11 November 2026.
quote: Une ouverture exceptionnelle est proposée du 14/02 au 01/03 : de 09h30 à 17h00... Une offre est valable du 28/03/2026 au 11/11/2026, selon les horaires d'ouverture réguliers.

claim: The Benedictine Abbaye de Gembloux (~11 km west of Liernu, now the Gembloux Agro-Bio Tech faculty of ULiège) opens for ticketed 90-minute guided tours on only four 2026 summer dates — Sat 11 Jul, Sun 26 Jul, Sat 8 Aug, Sun 23 Aug — at 14h00 for €5 adult / €1 child under 12.
quote: Saturday, July 11 at 2:00 p.m.; Sunday, July 26 at 2:00 p.m.; Saturday, August 8 at 2:00 p.m.; Sunday, August 23 at 2:00 p.m. Summer visits: €5 per person... Children under 12: €1.

claim: Château de Spontin — one of the few Belgian châteaux with an authentic working drawbridge — opens Tue-Sun 10h-17h in July-August and Wed/Sat/Sun 14h-17h in Sept-Oct, with €8 adult / €5 child admission and a strong recommendation to call ahead at +32 451 03 25 20 since private events can close advertised dates.
quote: Juillet & août : Du mardi au dimanche, de 10h à 17h. Septembre, octobre : Mercredi, samedi et dimanche 14h – 17h. Adults: €8. Children (under 12): €5.

claim: Spontin sits in the Bocq valley about 30 km southeast of Liernu — well inside the half-day radius — and its 2026 schedule adds an exceptional opening 27 April–10 May plus the spring half-term holidays.
quote: Le château sera ouvert du 27 avril au 10 mai, puis du 1er au 31 août, du mardi au dimanche de 10h à 17h. Le château sera également ouvert pendant les deux semaines des vacances de printemps de 14h à 17h.

claim: Crupet's Grotte Saint-Antoine de Padoue — a free, always-open 1900-1903 plaster-and-cast-iron tableau famous for its devil scene — draws over 10,000 visitors a year and combines well with a stroll past the Donjon de Carondelet in one of Wallonia's Plus Beaux Villages.
quote: Built between 1900 and 1903... The grotto contains scenes from the life of Saint Anthony, recreated with plaster and cast iron statues, with the devil scene being the most famous. The grotto attracts more than 10,000 visitors per year. Entrance is free.

claim: The 13th-century Donjon de Carondelet of Crupet — restored through 2020 and considered Belgium's best-preserved medieval fortified tower — is private property only opened to the public during Heritage Days in September; for other dates visitors must inquire at the Assesse tourism office.
quote: Le Donjon Carondelet est une propriété privée, il n'est pas visitable, sauf lors des Journées du Patrimoine.

claim: Château de Franc-Waret, a classical 18th-century pile just northeast of Namur on a 1,600-hectare estate with French gardens and an English park, is private and only accessible by prior appointment — making it a fit for chance event bookings, not a drop-in half-day option.
quote: Le château et son magnifique parc sont accessibles uniquement sur rendez-vous... Le domaine de Franc-Waret est entièrement privé.

claim: Maredsous Abbey's guided tours run every Saturday, Sunday and public holiday at 14h00 and 16h00 (15h30 in winter) plus daily during school holidays, at €9 adult / €7.50 senior-student / free under 12, with separate Taste Tour (cheese museum + microbrewery + beer-and-cheese tasting) and Distillery options.
quote: Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays: 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM (3:30 PM in winter). Cost: €9 per person; children under 12 are free; seniors and students pay €7.50.

claim: Maredsous lies in the Molignée valley near Denée roughly 30-33 km south of Liernu — at the outer edge of the 30 km radius — and pairs naturally with the area's draisines and Annevoie gardens for a fuller day out.
quote: Maredsous Abbey... located in the heart of the Molignee Valley... founded in 1872.
